description: List the organization's client review links (batch review links), newest first, with how many posts each one covers. Paged: returns { reviewLinks, page, limit, total }, 50 per page by default (max 100); `total` counts every link, so request the next page while page × limit < total. Pro and Business only: on the single-seat Free and Lifetime plans this answers 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with the plan and an upgrade hint. Use this when the user wants to see the client review links they have created for batches of posts.
name: list_review_links
title: List client review links
